# Ethen Pociask — Protocol Security & AI Infrastructure

> Protocol security and infrastructure engineer building decentralized and AI systems.
> Currently Eigen Labs. Previously Coinbase protocol security and Shadow EVM engineering.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ethen.me): Portfolio, experience, projects, and beliefs. Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Eigen Labs.
- [Agent Harness Lessons](https://ethen.me/writing/agent-harness-lessons): War stories from running an AI agent harness on Apple Silicon for a month — model selection, prompt caching, parallel agents, tool execution at scale, and operational lessons.
- [Portal](https://ethenotethan.github.io/portal/): Open-source macOS and iOS operations console for AI agents, with streaming chat, multi-gateway sessions, knowledge graphs, artifacts, skills, cron, and learning tools.
- [Google Meet Conversation Agent](https://github.com/ethenotethan/gmeet-pipeline): Real-time meeting agent that joins calls, consumes transcripts, routes context through LLMs and memory, and streams generated speech back into the conversation.

## About

Ethen Pociask is a Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Eigen Labs with 6+ years in software engineering and deep experience across AI infrastructure, protocol security, EVM engineering, and distributed systems. His work includes a self-hosted AI agent harness, native agent clients, a real-time meeting agent, production threat monitoring for OP Stack blockchains, and an Arbitrum Orbit fork integrated with EigenDA.

Key interests: Ethereum Rollups, Zero Knowledge Cryptography, Distributed Systems, LLMs & AI Agents, EVM Scalability, Systems Design, Computer Networks.
